invariants: The prediction stage declares the selected encoder, all eleven data inputs, and the two historical configuration files.
The adapter invokes the selected fit-only raw-gene readout with fit-only memory, top-k 1600, and temperature 0.055.
The evaluation stage consumes the produced prediction and score artifacts and accepts only the historical hold PearsonDelta within the declared tolerance.
Both stages use VIPER's declared file-access boundary and the selected receipt is the experiment estimator.

findings.summary: The prediction stage read hold truth and scored its own output, contradicting the approved prediction-to-evaluation boundary.
findings.repair: Move hold truth and PearsonDelta scoring into the evaluation stage and preserve attention metadata as the prediction-stage edge.

exclusions: The restored-input replay remains the P0-PB-07 completion gate.
